summary:
Implemented two iPhone-visible slices:

- Added Quick Sheet Tow / Shop Arrival Pack in `quick-sheet.html`, wired through `quick-sheet.js`, styled for mobile/light theme, searchable via `search-data.js`, and reachable from the Quick Sheet bottom bar.
- Hardened Quick Sheet and Diagnostics Garage-note save paths so owner-auth write blocks no longer show false â€œsavedâ€ statuses or receipts.

Also updated `service-worker.js` to `ridgeline-console-v446`, expanded browser smoke coverage for the new Arrival workflow, fixed the smoke seed drift, updated `AGENT_STATE.md`, and closed `agent-last-run.json`.

Verification passed:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html')`
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('diagnostics.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `node --check` for changed JS
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1` PowerShell parse check
- Direct iPhone-width hosted probes for Quick Sheet Arrival and Diagnostics owner lock
- `git diff --check` passed with only LF-to-CRLF warnings

Next slice: harden the same owner-write status pattern in Maintenance/Fuse workflows.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Quick Sheet now has an Arrival handoff reachable from the iPhone bottom bar for tow/shop handoffs after a roadside event.
Impact Reason: It turns existing roadside contact and checkpoint state into a one-tap handoff and prevents confusing false save confirmations when owner access is locked.
Ended Early Because: The run reached a clean point after two verified slices; the next save-status hardening pass spans Maintenance/Fuse workflows and is better handled as its own focused slice.
